title: fisc rung answer
description: Go's reading of a page's declared drill steps against the documents they draw: for every opened path, which nodes each column of the resulting chart holds, and which marks the client adds that no page prints. NOT A RE-ENCODING OF THE DECLARATIONS -- every figure here is computed over a document, so the client comparing against it is comparing against what Go says the chart holds rather than against a second reading of its own.

generated_by.description: The export that wrote this answer. The page carries the same string as exported_by, and the client refuses a pair that disagree: they are separate files with no cache-busting between them, so a reader can hold one from before the last deploy.

draws.description: One entry per column of the chart this rung draws, in the order the reader meets them left to right. A COLUMN SAYS WHAT IT HOLDS, NOT WHAT WOULD FIT: the ids are unfolded and no cap has been applied, because which of them a viewport leaves room for is the client's.

ids.description: Written even when empty, so a column the document draws nothing at can be told from a column that was not answered. A reader that accepted the absence would read the first as the second.

amounts.description: The figure a mark prints, for the nodes on this rung whose drawn ribbons do not add up to it. Every other mark is the sum of its ribbons and has no entry; a node a schedule prints a reduction under is the exception, because the reduction is drawn forward at its magnitude and the arriving ribbons come to the figure plus twice the reductions. The client draws a node at the amount named here if one is named and lets the layout size it otherwise.

marks.description: The marks the client draws on this rung that no page prints: the gap between what the chart above sends into the opened node and what the drawn document breaks it into, and the residual standing beside the opened node's parts.

label.description: What the mark is called on the chart. A residual is named for the grain its step's document does not split that money by; a gap is named for the disagreement it stands for.

rationale.description: Why the mark exists, in the words the step declares. A claim about what the documents do and do not decompose, so it is composed here and not in the client.

source_note.description: What the mark's figure is and is not. Empty on a residual, whose note renders the citations of the flows it carries and is the client's; stated on a gap, whose figure is a difference no page prints.
